summary: After the ARTICLE_YOUR binding fix, all 29 screens and cursors match the accepted v39 recording. The remaining divergence is two omitted RNG calls after mon.c:newcham changes the mounted pony into a form that cannot be ridden: C calls steed.c:poly_steed, which reaches dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_FELL) and landing_spot. JS still records note_unported("steed.c poly_steed"), and its FELL switch arm is unsupported.

source.branch: When a mounted monster changes form, mon.c:newcham calls poly_steed. If the new form cannot be saddled or ridden, poly_steed calls dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_FELL). dismount_steed initializes have_spot with landing_spot before switching on the reason; landing_spot scans adjacent squares and uses rn2(viable) for equal-distance viable locations.

evidence: Saved accepted evaluation challenges/evaluations/accepted-2b9c8c0ca07c0bef46254ff825aa31ef3a2956ba-v39.json at 2b9c8c0ca07c0bef46254ff825aa31ef3a2956ba; v39 manifest SHA-256 02e1d34e578b14e273a1916991d10e6ce67e585118338a2c2d45f322b63e81d0, recording SHA-256 1a61a52d42ce5f5596e73f970f91b94ef2b87d33b7740bc2eb6a2735dfb63997; 29/29 screens, 2640/2642 RNG calls, 29/29 cursors.

Fresh focused differential `node scripts/diff-fresh.mjs challenges/cases/v39/v39-mounted-steed-polymorph-trap.recipe.session.json` reproduced the same failure: screen and cursor streams match; C has 2642 RNG calls while JS has 2640; first missing call is rn2(3)=2 from steed.c:landing_spot at segment 0 step 28 (printed as segment 1 step 29 in the CLI). Bounded receipt: /tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-BHW5cy/receipt.json.

Source path: trap.c:steedintrap calls newcham(steed, NULL, NC_SHOW_MSG); mon.c:newcham calls poly_steed(mtmp, olddata) after the monster form and gear are updated. In steed.c:poly_steed, a new form that fails can_saddle() or can_ride() calls dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_FELL).

Source path: steed.c:dismount_steed initializes have_spot with landing_spot(&cc, reason, 0) before its reason switch. DISMOUNT_FELL follows the thrown/knocked fall branch. landing_spot at line 543 breaks ties among viable adjacent squares with rn2(viable), accounting for the first missing call.

Likely JS gaps: js/mon.js:apply_newcham_steps still calls note_unported("steed.c poly_steed") for state.u.usteed; js/steed.js:dismount_steed throws UnsupportedSteedError for DISMOUNT_FELL. Existing js/steed.js landing_spot is already wired and runs before the dismount switch.

The earlier ARTICLE_YOUR binding defect in mon.c:newcham was corrected and independently accepted. It accounts for the prior 0/29 replay stop; the current evidence supersedes that old remaining-screen count while retaining the naming fix as history.

An independent unmounted pet-polymorph recording remains in recipes/mon.c/tame-pet-polymorph-trap.session.json and recordings/mon.c/tame-pet-polymorph-trap.session.json; it matches 25/25 screens, 2850/2850 RNG calls, and 25/25 cursors, proving the mon.c:newcham tame naming path without entering the mounted branch.
